main_claim: The full strict unit graph on three unit circles and their distinct centres is four-colourable whenever one centre pair is more than three apart.
domination_corollary: Every dominating triple in a five-chromatic plane unit-distance graph is independent and has diameter at most three.
fresh_family: arbitrary separated triples; no Parts or A5 input
stop_boundary: distance exactly three and triples of diameter at most three remain open
